ownerStatement: Approved by repeat98 on 14 Nov 2026 in the session that measured the modules' cost at rest ("prepare" for releasing 0.3.3 as measured, then "write the approval for me", after reading what the approval waives): release POLY8 0.3.3-experimental.
reason: 0.3.3 changes only how POLY8's frame-interrupt hooks treat tracks that are not POLY8's: a stock track's render goes straight to stock's call after one inline test, whether each track is POLY8's is worked out once a frame for all eight tracks, and a dirty mark keeps a track that leaves POLY8 dropping its voices and keys. On the owner's MKII (development twin 0277c5c5 of main, 14 Nov 2026, four FLEX tracks playing at 126 BPM, POLY8 on no track) it costs +4.9 points of the frame interrupt at rest against +12.2 for 0.3.1; a one-voice POLY8 track on T1 recorded over USB is sample-identical to 0.3.1 for a bar. The UI and pages are 0.2.7's, so its captures are retained; an emulator probe matches poly_is_track on every case tried. Waived for this exact source: chords, several voices, several POLY8 tracks, MIDI, recorded chords, listening by ear, Part/project reload and power cycles on a unit, the card build on a unit, chip worst-case cycles and complete memory bounds.
